text:
elen: FYI, after the recent fused-op reorder merge (merge 0x7f9c) canary shows a short-seq decode p95 regression. holding rollout for now.

sam: seen it too. CI perf job failed on shortseq suite: `decode_shortseq_p95` jumped ~2.4x.

matt: logs? any kernel fallback visible in traces?

elen: pasted the microtrace below from a failing canary instance (sequence <=16 samples):
```
[trace] request_id=rq-83a: decode: enter step=generate token=1
[perf] selected_kernel=attn_fused_v3
[perf] fallback_path=attn_generic_slow
[profile] kernel_time_attn_fused_v3=0.7ms (20%)
[profile] kernel_time_attn_generic=2.8ms (80%)
[total_decode] p95=92ms (baseline 38ms)
```

chi: interesting — selected_kernel says fused v3 but then fallback to generic. I suspect the fused path is returning an error or hitting a guard and we drop to generic. Could be an alignment/stride regression after the reorder.

tanya: CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/1222/perf-shortseq.html (attached heatmaps). Short batches (bs=1-4) are worst.

sam: I ran a quick local repro with env toggles: `REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED=1` vs `0` — with fused disabled p95 returns to baseline. so fused reorder seems causal.

matt: can we bisect the fused-op PR chain? which commit introduced the stride change?

elen: bisect in progress. current suspect range: PRs 1398..1426 (reorder + micro-optim). will run perf bisection on canary fleet.

ops-bot: Canary rolling back to previous stable kernel choice on 3/5 nodes as a precaution.

chi: repro script I'm using (short snippet):
```
python reproduce_shortseq.py --model redwood/opt-2.7b --seq 16 --batch 2 --iters 200 --trace-kernels
```
Outputs show `attn_fused_v3` failing pyc check and then scheduler re-assigns to `attn_generic` which is much slower for small seq.

tanya: CI perf failure details:
- job: `perf/decode/shortseq`
- baseline p95: 38ms
- current p95: 92ms
- threshold: 50ms -> FAILED
- flaky? no, 6/6 runs reproduce on canary.

sam: proposed mitigations:
1) emergency revert of the fused-op reorder commit (fast but disruptive), or
2) add a runtime guard: if fallback observed or seq<=32 && batch<=4, force old kernel (cheap), or
3) fix the root cause in fused implementation (longer).

matt: +1 for 2) as a short-term canary fix while we root-cause. avoids full revert and keeps other perf wins. we should also add an assert that logs the precise guard failure on fused path.

elen: I can land a temporary heuristic patch to force `attn_fused_v2` / disable `v3` for small sequences and push canary. will include extra logging to capture the guard that triggers fallback.

chi: please include stack + vector strides in the log when fallback happens. saving that will make the actual fix much faster.

tanya: also add a targeted perf test to CI: shortseq with bs=1..4 should run nightly against canary to catch regressions fast.

sam: action items:
- elen -> land heuristic patch in canary and add detailed fallback logging (ETA 2h)
- matt -> prepare a minimal revert PR if heuristics fail (PR ready but not merged)
- chi -> run bisection and share commit range + repro artifacts (ETA 4h)
- tanya -> update perf CI to add shortseq gate and unmute artifacts (ETA next deploy)

deploy-bot: Canary hold enabled: rollout flag `decode_fused_kernel_v3` set to OFF for canary-1/2/3.

matt: reminder: if we do heuristic, add unit tests for kernel-selector to avoid config drift. also add a canary-only smoke check that runs small-batch decode after every rollout.

elen: patch pushed to canary branch: `runtime: prefer attn_fused_v2 for small seqs` (diff short). logs now include `fused_guard_code` and strides. initial canary runs show p95 back to 40-45ms.

chi: saw the logs from the patched canary — guard code is `GUARD_STRIDE_MISMATCH` and stride values are inconsistent when using v3 on certain attention dims (nvcc alignment edge-case). sending crash dump to gpu-team.

tanya: holding main rollout until we have fix + 24h of stable canary metrics. marking as rollout-blocked and filing incident ticket INC-2026.

sam: long-term: we should add a continuous matrix of shortseq/batch combos in perf lab with nightly A/B between fused variants. also add auto-rollback triggers if shortseq p95 breaches thresholds during rollout.

elen: agreed. for now I'll keep monitoring canary and forward any failing repro logs. will post updates here.

matt: thanks all — big win getting a quick heuristic in. once gpu-team confirms root cause, we can re-enable v3 with a proper fix.

elen: update 3112233555: canary p95 stabilized at ~42ms across 6/6 nodes. will keep the hold for 24h.

chi: bisection narrowed down to commit `a1f3be2` in PR 1417 that changed vector packing order; looks like it introduced an off-by-one in stride calc when fused reordered matmuls. sending patch to gpu-team.
